invariants.rationale: root is dereferenced in the method via getChildByName, so must not be null.
tideFile is passed to getRelativeFileHandle, so must not be null.
tilesheets is dereferenced in the for loop, so TileSheets child must exist.
The collection of TileSheet children is a list and cannot be negative size.
tideFile is used to resolve image files, so it should exist.
